summary: Implemented several frontend-side changes aimed at improving monthly liquidity-zone detection (including enhanced reversal-structure span/body-wick calculations and richer dev diagnostics) and persisting untouched boxes across recomputations. Added a development-only regression fixture runner and a hard-coded candle fixture. However, the diff summary does not provide clear evidence that the chart rendering path now deterministically maps boxes using candleIndex with clamping/stable keys, nor that coordinate-resolution render-failure warnings exist, and the REQ-30 fixture appears to run via dev console assertions rather than a frontend build/test test harness.
